# Sumukh Singh Portfolio — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org

> Sumukh Singh is a creative strategist and content marketer based in Delhi, India. He builds campaigns, content systems, and short-form creative for startups, founders, and growing teams.

## About

Sumukh Singh works across creative strategy, campaign systems, viral short-form video, brand positioning, analytics, and website development. He is available for freelance and consulting engagements.

Contact: sumukh.workk@gmail.com

## Selected Work

- **Swiggy Instamart campaign** — viral short-form content, 2.1M views in 24 hours.
- **Blinkit Metrics Dashboard** — Power BI analytics dashboard, ₹1.2M in sales data analyzed.
- **Fokus app** — short-form content system and hook writing.
- **Josh Talks AI** — landing page redesign, editorial UX.
- **Launchverse** — multi-brand product launch strategy and execution.
- **Slack × Swiggy HQ** — brand partnership creative direction.
